blurb: Everyone in Coldwater came through here once, wet and already owing somebody.
name: Ironside
signature: Grit off the road finds your teeth before you have walked ten yards.
Somebody haggles over batteries, loudly, and settles for less.
The launderette vents hot wet air across the pavement and nobody minds.
A clone stands in the facility doorway getting used to weather.
skyline: the Clone Facility breathes steam over Ironside Street
